headlines.title: McDonald's (MCD), What Is Behind The Fresh Attention?
headlines.summary: McDonald's (MCD) is back in the spotlight as early signs of a U.S. sales recovery intersect with costly restaurant remodels, value bundle tests, and franchisee pushback, which is sharpening investor attention on execution risk. Recent trading reflects that mix of optimism and caution. McDonald's 1 month share price return of 12.98% and 90 day gain of 5.16% point to building momentum from the remodel and value-menu narrative, even though the year to date share price is still down 7.

headlines.title: Wendy’s has inflated prices for up to 10 years, lawsuit claims — weeks after McDonald's was accused of a similar scheme
headlines.summary: The suit says a point-of-sale system did more than ring up orders. It allegedly fed data into pricing decisions across the whole franchise network.

headlines.title: Crispier Chicken and Remodels Pit McDonald's Against Franchisees
headlines.summary: Franchise owners are pushing back on the CEO's multibillion-dollar plan to tear down walls, add big video screens and make hand-breaded chicken. Bloomberg's Daniela Sirtori reports.

headlines.title: McDonald's Moves on Makeover; Dick's Sporting Goods Up on Earnings | Stock Movers
headlines.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Anthropic (ANT) shares are lower and briefly traded below their $83 initial public offering price in premarket trading, wiping out gains for investors who piled into the artificial intelligence lab's record-setting debut. - McDonald's (MCD) shares are moving on news the company's betting big on a makeover to win back customers. The chain is tearing down kitchen walls, adding hand-breaded chicken and trendy drinks, plus testing AI to take drive-thru orders. However, the nearly $800-thousand price tag per restaurant has franchisees pushing back and convincing them of the overhaul is becoming a big challenge for the fast food giant. - Dick's Sporting Goods (DKS) shares are climbing after the retailer's third-quarter results easily topped Street expectations. Management also boosted its adjusted EPS forecast for the full year, as well as the low end of its Dick's stores comparable sales target.

headlines.title: Monroe Capital Supports Waveborn’s Acquisition of Jake Rosen Entertainment
headlines.summary: CHICAGO, November 24, 2026--Monroe Capital LLC ("Monroe") announced it acted as sole lead arranger and administrative agent on the funding of a senior credit facility to support the acquisition of Jake Rosen Entertainment ("JRE") by Waveborn, a new investment platform formed by private equity sponsor H.I.G. Growth Partners.

description: McDonald's Corporation owns, operates, and franchises restaurants under the McDonald's brand in the United States and internationally. It offers food and beverages, including hamburgers and cheeseburgers, various chicken sandwiches, fries, shakes, frozen desserts, sundaes, soft serve cones, cookies, pies, soft drinks, coffee, and other beverages; and full or limited breakfast, as well as sells various other products during limited-time promotions. The company owns and operates franchised restaurants under various structures, including conventional franchise, developmental license, or affiliate. McDonald's Corporation was founded in 1940 and is based in Chicago, Illinois.
